citation: No external dataset records are directly imported. The benchmark is generated using project-defined URL patterns.
description: A project-generated synthetic benchmark containing benign and phishing-like URL patterns for academic experimentation. The dataset is not a verified real-world phishing or benign URL collection.
generation_method: Manually defined URL patterns and template-based expansion
grouping_method: Benign examples are grouped by normalized hostname. Phishing examples are grouped by detected brand or attack-pattern host.
